_about: Ground truth for the BI V3 pilot, checked by hand by Clément (3 Nov 2026) against run 20261103-161330-59c1e5. PoE = a place where a foreign pleasure boat completes entry formalities, according to a State source. See REPORT-EN.md / PROCEDURE-REVERIFICATION-EN.md.

criteria.all: State source only; guides, noonsite, agents and forums are secondary.
criteria.Martinique: Only marinas and capitaineries on the douane clearance list count; cybercafés, snack bars, shops, tourist office, customs brigade, fuel and careening stations are excluded.
criteria.Cape Verde: Only habilitated border posts (DL 2/2015 as amended by DL 13/2025, art. 2(1)); the art. 2(9) exception is not a PoE.
criteria.Canary Islands: Entry from outside EU/Schengen: habilitated border crossing points (Schengen Handbook Annex 4; Orden INT/859/2023 Annex V).

poe.name: Castries
poe.note: https://www.customs.gov.lc/uploads/customs_control_and_management_act_cap_15_05_f1ec58be23.pdf#page=180 – Customs Regulations reg.136(2)(h) (S.I. 241/2000), Laws of Saint Lucia Cap.15.05, PDF p.180 (printed p.176): 'at the boarding stations (a) Castries and Vieux-Fort (A) for the boarding and clearance of vessels 8:00am – 12 noon and 1:00pm – 4:00pm daily'. Arrival rule: Act s.21(1)(a) (PDF p.26): a vessel from abroad shall not 'arrive at any place other than a customs port'. 2026 check: still listed under 'Entry & Clearance Ports' by the Saint Lucia Tourism Authority (statutory body) https://stlucia.org/en/plan-your-saint-lucia-trip/navigation-clearance ('Castries – Primarily serves cruise liners and cargo vessels'); Customs Castries Port office https://customs.gov.lc/contact.

poe.name: Soufriere Bay

poe.name: Vieux-Fort
poe.note: https://www.customs.gov.lc/uploads/customs_control_and_management_act_cap_15_05_f1ec58be23.pdf#page=180 – Customs Regulations reg.136(2)(h) (S.I. 241/2000), Laws of Saint Lucia Cap.15.05, PDF p.180 (printed p.176): 'at the boarding stations (a) Castries and Vieux-Fort (A) for the boarding and clearance of vessels'. Customs office code 'Vieux-Fort Main Office 00VF' (PDF p.201). Arrival rule: Act s.21(1)(a) (PDF p.26): a vessel from abroad shall not 'arrive at any place other than a customs port'. 2026 check: not on stlucia.org entry list; Customs Notice No.1 of 2014 (Comptroller) says yacht 'clearance be obtained at the Customs office there [Vieux Fort]' https://www.customs.gov.lc/uploads/notice_2014_01_927e46363b.pdf#page=1; Customs still runs Vieux Fort Docks/Pier units https://customs.gov.lc/contact. Secondary: Cox & Co agent lists 5 ports incl. Vieux Fort (immigration at Hewanorra airport) https://coxcoltd.com/yachting-services/ports-of-entry-marinas.

not_poe.name: Arguineguín
not_poe.note: Arguineguín is not a Schengen border crossing point (EU Annex 4, Spain sea borders, pp.25-26). Regulation (EU) 2016/399 Annex VI 3.2.5 (DOUE L77, p.43 of https://www.boe.es/doue/2016/077/L00001-00052.pdf#page=43): "una embarcación de recreo procedente de un tercer país podrá entrar excepcionalmente en un puerto que no esté reconocido como paso fronterizo" (exception only). Under 3.2.4, boats from an EU port may enter any port: see Clément decision on Schengen criterion. Spain RD 557/2011 art.1: entry "por los puestos habilitados al efecto" https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2011-7703 Criterion (Clément 03/11): port where a boat from OUTSIDE EU/Schengen may enter = habilitated border crossing point. Conclusion ❌ kept. Also not in Spain's national list: Orden INT/859/2023, Annex V "Puestos fronterizos", BOE 176 of 25/07/2023, pág. 108066 = https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2023/07/25/pdfs/BOE-A-2023-17072.pdf#page=35 (34 seaports; Canary ones: Arrecife, Las Palmas, Puerto Rosario, Santa Cruz de la Palma, Santa Cruz de Tenerife).

Under 3.2.4, boats from an EU port may enter any port: see Clément decision on Schengen criterion. Spain RD 557/2011 art.1: entry "por los puestos habilitados al efecto" https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2011-7703 Criterion (Clément 03/11): port where a boat from OUTSIDE EU/Schengen may enter = habilitated border crossing point. Conclusion ❌ kept. Also not in Spain's national list: Orden INT/859/2023, Annex V "Puestos fronterizos", BOE 176 of 25/07/2023, pág. 108066 = https://www.boe.es/boe/dias/2023/07/25/pdfs/BOE-A-2023-17072.pdf#page=35 (34 seaports; Canary ones: Arrecife, Las Palmas, Puerto Rosario, Santa Cruz de la Palma, Santa Cruz de Tenerife).
